main_body: Flat ground patch filling the whole frame (a 4x3 tile terrain block with a speckled green surface). It is not a standing object.
top_band: none: terrain surface with no standing volume, so there is no top band or front face to read
evidence: The whole image is a repeating dot-and-clump ground texture. It has no object silhouette, so none of the four 3/4 failure modes (front elevation, side elevation, top-down plan, rim only) apply. As a terrain tile it is acceptable.

style.flat_fills_note: no 5x5 area is one flat colour; the base green is broken up by speckles and dark/light clumps
style.evidence: The candidate has about 5 green steps: a base mid green, a slightly lighter and a slightly darker variant, dark clump shadows, and light highlight dots. The scattered dark clumps and light dots give each tile roughly 6-8 colours, which matches or beats the Beodeul grass reference, where the base is mostly flat with a few tufts. There are no outlines. The weak point is that the clump layout repeats very regularly, but it does not look thin or flat next to the reference.
